purpose: Test whether the corrected-control two-state M0 model has any joint feasible configuration across consumed cold-start and hot-start development evidence without identifying or selecting a physical parameter set.
global_parameter_rule: Each grid point uses one global configuration for both development tests. Per-run parameters are prohibited.
selection_rule: No best-fit configuration may be selected or reported as physically identified. The output is feasibility classification and aggregate coverage of the frozen grid only.

feasibility_rule.joint_feasible_configuration: A single frozen grid point must satisfy all evaluable whole-trace criteria on both 71207062 and 71207063 and the hot-region criterion wherever evaluable.

interpretation.zero_joint_feasible_grid_points: M0 corrected-control feasibility fails under the inherited V1 thermal snapshot and frozen uncertainty grid. This is strong development evidence but does not by itself prove every possible two-state thermal formulation impossible.
interpretation.one_or_more_joint_feasible_grid_points: M0 remains structurally viable. Passing grid points are not physical parameter estimates and additional independent constraints are required before blind execution.

outputs_allowed: parameter-wise min/max among feasible grid points without ranking
next_action_after_execution: Review FEAS-01 result before authorizing any M0 physical identification stage or M1 promotion.
